show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: When a young daughter insists on cleaning the family home, she uncovers a hidden past her father tried to bury forever. A simple chore becomes a turning point that changes their relationship and their lives forever.
